    p2 = ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value
    p3 = ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value
    if date_val is not None and item is not None:
        data.append((date_val, item, p1, p2, p3))

lookups = []

    lookups.append((row, item, param, date_recall))
